sections.changelog: v1.2.114: Separates Rank Math custom fields in Content Studio, preserves richer custom-field/meta values for safer editing, adds safe JetEngine-to-ACF migration preview/apply endpoints, merges CSS Studio settings and editor into one panel, fixes CSS variable autocomplete to wrap bare --tokens in var(), improves CSS Recipes editor spacing, tightens Media Studio context-menu anchoring, standardizes studio input height, and further stabilizes floating Bricks Structure/Elements manual positions.
